applicability.rationale: One package owns behavior and public/lifecycle shape is unchanged.

delegated.bounds: May change inside api if public contracts and lifecycle ownership remain intact.
May change if race-free behavior, terminal Close semantics, and evidence remain equivalent.

prohibited: Duplicating Service closed-state policy in cmd/app.
Returning an output channel without one explicit close owner.
Treating a passing race run as proof of goroutine termination.

acceptanceCriteria: Public API and error contracts are explicit.
Package and goroutine/channel ownership are unambiguous.
Cancellation and shutdown have direct evidence.

artifactTopology.responsibility: Own public Record, Store, Service, ErrClosed, and Stream contracts.
Construct the service and consume public API without owning domain lifecycle semantics.
Prove close, cancellation, stream shutdown, error identity, and wire behavior.

failureAndRecovery: store error is returned without hidden retry
behaviorPaths.name: Command save

steps.interaction: Save with propagated context and Record

behaviorPaths.success: Record is handled once and command observes success.
behaviorPaths.trigger: command constructs Service and invokes Save

behaviorPaths.name: Cancellable stream

steps.interaction: provide context and receive-only input channel
return receive-only output channel and close it on completion

behaviorPaths.success: Records are forwarded in order until input closes.
behaviorPaths.trigger: caller invokes Stream with context and input channel

effectBoundaries.failure: error is returned; no hidden retry

effectBoundaries.recovery: context cancellation or input close terminates

failureSemantics: untrusted runtime data is validated before trusted use
invariants: nil and empty fields have documented JSON behavior
keyContracts.name: Record
keyContracts.shape: type Record struct { ID string; Tags map[string]string; Value []byte }

failureSemantics: partial effects and retryability are implementation contracts
keyContracts.name: Store
keyContracts.shape: type Store interface { Save(context.Context, Record) error }

failureSemantics: context cancellation and store errors return without hidden retry
keyContracts.name: Service
keyContracts.responsibility: Own closed-state transition and bounded save lifecycle.

keyContracts.name: ErrClosed
keyContracts.responsibility: Stable caller classification of closed service.

observabilityPoints.statement: Command exit and output show success/failure without leaking record contents.
Tests observe output closure and no post-cancel delivery.

stateOwnership.concurrency: Save and Close may race safely
stateOwnership.recovery: closed state is terminal for the instance

stateOwnership.concurrency: caller owns input send/close; Stream owns output close
stateOwnership.consistency: single close owner and context-aware send
stateOwnership.lifetime: until input closes or context is cancelled
stateOwnership.mutationAuthority: owned goroutine is sole output sender and closer

testSeams.statement: Inject a deterministic Store fake and assert Save/error behavior.
Use bounded channels and cancellation to prove output close and goroutine termination.

subject.purpose: Expose a public Record/Store/Service API and bounded streaming lifecycle through a command consumer.
